categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the industrial filtration materials sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of filtration cloths and bags. Its products serve key industries such as power generation (especially coal-fired power plants), cement, chemical, metallurgy, mining, waste incineration, food, pharmaceuticals, environmental protection, and new energy. The business includes two main product lines: non-woven series (needle-punched non-woven filtration cloth and bags) and woven series (woven filtration cloth and bags).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced textile technologies including needle-punched non-woven fabric production and various weaving techniques (plain, twill, satin) for woven fabrics. It utilizes specialized fiber materials such as polypropylene (PP), polyester (PET), aramid, PPS, and PTFE, with proprietary processes like ultra-fine fiber treatment, fabric reinforcement, heat setting, coating, and nano-coating technologies. The production is highly customized to meet diverse filtration requirements and harsh operating conditions, supported by automated and intelligent manufacturing lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are industrial enterprises requiring filtration solutions for dust removal and wastewater treatment, including coal-fired power plants, steel mills, cement factories, chemical plants, waste incineration facilities, and environmental protection companies. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant sales in China and overseas markets such as North America and Europe. Customers demand high-performance filtration materials to comply with increasingly stringent environmental regulations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Zhejiang Province. It has subsidiaries and sales networks covering major domestic regions and international markets, including a wholly-owned subsidiary in the United States (Mid Atlantic Industrial Textiles, Inc.) and distributors or strategic partners in Europe and Southeast Asia. The company’s products are sold globally, with about 37% of revenue from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the filtration materials supply chain, producing key filtration components such as filtration cloths and bags that are critical consumables for industrial dust and liquid filtration equipment. It also extends upstream by investing in raw material fiber production and downstream by providing customized filtration solutions and technical services to end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes innovation in high-performance filtration materials, including multi-functional PTFE filter bags, self-assembled coating technologies, and composite high-temperature resistant materials. It collaborates with universities and research institutes to develop advanced filtration technologies for industrial pollution control and new application fields. The company is expanding production capacity with intelligent manufacturing and focusing on product quality, customization, and broadening applications in emerging sectors like new energy and consumer filtration products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of filtration cloths and bags, which are physical products sold mainly via direct sales channels domestically and through distributors internationally. The company also earns income from customized filtration solutions and technical services. It has limited revenue from financial investments and government subsidies, which are non-recurring and ancillary to its core business.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic filtration materials supplier in China, recognized as a high-tech and specialized 'little giant' enterprise with strong R&D capabilities and a broad product portfolio. It competes with other domestic and international filtration material manufacturers, leveraging its scale, technology, and comprehensive product range to maintain a competitive edge. The company’s brand 'Yanpai' is well-known in the filtration industry, and it holds a strong market share in key industrial sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 784.6 million, representing an 8.75% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 42.18 million, a decline of 35.72% year-over-year, partly due to increased costs and investments. Total assets grew by 38.08% to RMB 2.07 billion, and net assets attributable to shareholders increased by 4.36% to RMB 1.02 billion. The company is expanding capacity and investing heavily in R&D and production facilities, indicating a growth-oriented profile despite short-term profit pressure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its advanced filtration technology, extensive customization capabilities, and comprehensive product range covering both woven and non-woven filtration materials. It emphasizes high filtration efficiency, durability under harsh industrial conditions, and compliance with stringent environmental standards. Its ability to provide integrated filtration solutions and strong technical support, combined with scale advantages and a reputable brand, offers customers reliable, high-quality products that improve filtration performance and operational efficiency.
